To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the predominant ras mutation in lung and HG neoplams induced by chloroprene and isoprene is an A-->T codon 61 transversion.
the predominant mutation in chlorprene-induced lung and Harderain gland neoplasims was an A--> T transversion at K-Ras codon 6.
the predominant K-ras mutations in lung and Hardern gland tumors of B6CF3F1 mice induced by 2-chlorobutadiene (chloroprene) are A-->T transversations at codon 61.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of genetic alterations in the ras oncogenes associated with the induction of lung and Harderin gland neoplasia by chloroprene.
the identification of the molecular mechanisms of chloroprene and isoprene carcinogenesis.
the identification of the genetic alterations that occur during carcinogenesis and the elucidation of their role in the development of cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
K-ras codons 13 and 61 mutations are associated with chloroprene-induced tumors.
chloroprene-induced K-ras mutations in lung and HG neoplasm of B6C2F1 mice are similar to those induced by isoprene but different from those of 1, 3-butadiene.
K-ras A -->T transversions in mice are associated with exposure to 1,3-dienes, and that this mutation is not associated with exposure to mono- or polyunsaturated alkenes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the K-ras codons 13 and 61 are important for the tumor induction of 1, 3-butadiene and isoprene, while the K-ras 61 codon is important for chloroprene.
K-ras codons 12, 13 and 61 are the most common sites for mutation in lung neoplasia induced by chloroprene, isoprene and butadiene.
the K-ras A --> T mutation is a marker for exposure to this chemical class of compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the K-ras codons 12 and 61 are the major sites for mutation by 2-chloroprene and isoprene, while codon 13 is the major site of mutation by 1,3- butadiene.
the chloroprene-induced K-ras mutation spectrum was similar to that of isoprene, but different from that of 1, 3-butadiene.
the K-ras A->T mutation is a common mutation in chloroprenes induced lung and Harderien gland neoplasias.
